title: Polynomial positivity cones for Coxeter roots and walks in trees
summary: For a finite simple graph $G$ and an integer $k\ge0$, let $w_k(G)$ denote the number of walks of length $k$. We prove the conjecture of Täubig, Weihmann, Kosub, Hemmecke, and Mayr for every finite tree and determine all equality cases. If $T$ has $n\ge1$ vertices, then $n w_{k+1}(T)-2(n-1)w_k(T)\ge0$ for every $k\ge1$; for $n\ge3$, equality holds if and only if $T$ is a star and $k$ is even, whereas for $n=1$ or $n=2$, equality holds for every $k\ge1$.
